Git writes will half-complete and litter .git/objects. Leftover probe: .selfheal_probe Class B: the safe failure mode is declared, so the loop degrades and continues rather than escalating. The work is not lost, it is unlanded, and those are different states (L-062).

escalations.why: A workflow whose declared permissions disagree with what its steps do, or whose script set has drifted from the local control set, is a governance defect rather than a drifted artefact. Rewriting a permissions block automatically would let the loop widen its own authority, which is the one thing G-07 refuses outright.
